summary: Comprehensive testing of Balance/Prepayment System completed. All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified: account page balance display, topup modal, history modal, and checkout page balance payment option. Successfully placed order with balance payment - balance was correctly deducted and transaction recorded.

backend_api_tests: GET /api/prepayment-settings - Public endpoint returns settings (no auth required)
GET /api/user/balance - Returns current user balance with auth
POST /api/user/balance/topup - Card topup succeeds instantly (mock mode)
POST /api/user/balance/topup - Crypto topup creates pending transaction
Topup transactions appear in balance history
GET /api/admin/balance-transactions - Returns all transactions with user info
Balance payment integration verified on order creation
frontend_account_page_tests: Topup modal opens with amount input
Card and Crypto payment methods selectable
Card topup succeeds - balance increases immediately
History modal shows all transactions with type, amount, date
Topup transactions appear in history with positive amounts
Payment transactions appear in history with negative amounts
frontend_checkout_page_tests: Checkout page loads with balance payment option visible
Balance option shows current balance amount
Balance option can be selected (purple highlight)
When balance selected, no payment discount applied
Form fields work (fullname, address, phone, comment)
Place order button enabled after terms acceptance
Success message shows 'Заказ оплачен с баланса!'
Balance deducted after order (6,500₽ → 3,500₽ for 3,000₽ order)
Payment transaction recorded in balance history

critical_code_review_comments: Balance routes properly exclude MongoDB _id from responses
Topup validation correctly enforces min/max amounts from settings
Card topup correctly credits balance immediately (mock mode by design)
Order creation correctly deducts balance and creates transaction record
Balance transaction linked to order_id for audit trail
Frontend correctly shows balance payment option only when prepayment_enabled=true and balance > 0

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All account page and checkout balance features working)

seed_data_creation: Created balance topup transactions during testing (card and crypto topups)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Balance/Prepayment system fully functional. User has balance of 3,500₽ after test order. Mock payment mode means card topups credit instantly. Crypto topups without tx_hash create pending transactions. Balance payment on checkout deducts from user balance and records transaction. Admin can manage prepayment settings (enable/disable, min/max amounts) and view all transactions.

features_verified.balance_history: PASS - Shows all transactions with type and amount
features_verified.checkout_balance_option: PASS - Shows when balance > 0 and prepayment enabled
features_verified.order_with_balance: PASS - Deducts balance and records transaction
features_verified.admin_view_transactions: PASS - View all transactions with user info
